# Pixera
> Pixera is a macOS screenshot editor for styling, annotation, privacy redaction, and polished export-ready screenshots.

## Product Summary
- macOS desktop app for polishing screenshots after capture
- Blur, gradients, adaptive insets, rounded corners, and shadows
- Arrows, labels, callouts, and screenshot annotation workflows
- On-device privacy redaction for emails, API keys, and other sensitive data
- Export-ready screenshots for docs, support, launch posts, and social media
- Comparison pages for buyers choosing between Pixera, CleanShot X, Shottr, Snagit, and Xnapper
